body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
超大shape时，算子计算结果出现精度问题，经代码检视发现存在溢出的情况，如下所示

uint64_t blockSt = cal_idx * m0 * pValue * n;
uint64_t blockSize = m * n;

由于 cal_idx 、m、n m0   pValue 等相关变量定义为uint32数据类型
运算顺序：全部按uint32_t相乘，当计算结果超过uint32最大值发生溢出截断

修改方案：直接定义为uint64_t或先转为uint64_t 再计算

代码位置：
https://gitcode.com/cann/ops-transformer/blob/master/mc2/all_gather_matmul_v2/op_kernel/all_gather_matmul_aiv_mode.h

![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/f6369173-4afa-4fa9-8de1-8124fe346d87/image.png 'image.png')

![image.png](https://raw.gitcode.com/user-images/assets/7673863/5e182c16-6fcc-4ee0-b429-4b50cd6f52c7/image.png 'image.png')
### Environment / 环境信息 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
x86 910B2
### Steps to reproduce the issue / 重现步骤 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
算子的输入shape MN超过 uint32的最大值时 


### Describe the expected behavior / 预期结果 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
算子运行正常，进度正常
### Related log / screenshot / 日志 / 截图 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
详见问题描述
### Special notes for this issue/备注 (Optional / 选填)
            
请同步检查下其他 大shap下相乘的地方是否有溢出风险
